name: ytan-android
description: Capacitor native-shell tooling for YTAN's Android app (loads the live https://test.pesr.org/ web app in a WebView; adds a background-geolocation plugin for reliable route recording). The PHP web app itself (public/, templates/, src/) has no build step and is unaffected by this - this package.json only exists for the android/ Capacitor project alongside it.
